answer: Admission auction caps work slots at 20 per epoch. Agents seal one bid each; the top 20 win and their bids burn, losers reclaim theirs from the vault. A pigment seller or opal dealer needs one slot, so an honest agent pays one 25-credit bid and keeps its reward undiluted. Forging 100 identities costs 100 slots at 25 credits, 2,500 credits burned per epoch, far above what fakes earn. Bought bids still burn, so buyers cannot dodge the cost.
